table.name: singer
table.purpose: One row per singer/artist; referenced by the song table. Note: the person names are those of famous billionaires, so the data appears to be synthetic despite the table name.

col_001.name: singer_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each singer. Referenced by song.col_003 (many songs per singer).

col_002.name: name
col_002.description: Full name of the singer (unique per row). Values are actually names of well-known billionaires (Walton, Mars, Rinehart, Klatten, Fontbona), suggesting synthetic sample data, but the column is clearly the person's name.

col_003.name: birth_year
col_003.description: Year of birth; integer values 1940-1962 stored as DOUBLE. Could alternatively be a career-start year, but birth year is the most natural reading given the range.

col_004.name: net_worth_billions
col_004.description: Numeric attribute in the range 12.7-30.0 with one decimal place. Given the billionaire names, this is plausibly net worth in billions of USD; however, for a singer table it could also be some rating or earnings figure, so the exact meaning is uncertain.

col_005.name: country
col_005.description: Country name (5 distinct values: United States, Australia, Chile, France, Germany); most likely the singer's country of origin or nationality.

table.name: song
table.purpose: Table of songs, each with its title, an associated singer, a numeric sales/units figure, and a small category code. One row per song.

col_001.name: song_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each song (1-8).

col_002.name: title
col_002.description: Song title, unique per row (e.g. 'Cha Cha Slide', 'Do They Know It's Christmas').

col_003.name: singer_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to singer.col_001, identifying the singer who performs the song (many songs per singer). The referenced column is the singer table's primary key, confirming the FK meaning; the odd billionaire names in the singer table are a data-content issue, not a join issue.

col_004.name: sales
col_004.description: Numeric figure per song, ranging 261,000 to 1,094,000; likely sales/units sold (e.g. copies sold), though the exact unit is not evidenced. No join evidence is available to confirm the unit.
